name: Banh da Do Luong
summary: Bánh đa Đô Lương is the sesame rice cracker the city portal’s eight-specialty article ties to the center of the country. The cracker is about 20 cm across, with a lot of black sesame, so it is nutty and fragrant. In Đô Lương it is grilled over than hoa or fried in oil or fat until it is thin and light. Đô Lương is another commune.
origin: Đô Lương. The city portal’s eight-specialty article and its food-culture page name the cracker on the Nghệ table.
texture: The city portal says the cracker is small, about 20 cm, heavily seeded with black sesame, and cooked until thin and light.
taste: The city portal says the sesame makes it nutty and fragrant.
howToEat: Eat the cracker grilled over charcoal or fried in oil or fat. The city portal says it is thin and light. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Đô Lương, not a Vinh street. A lane was not printed. Check on arrival.
